answer: Something I'd add is a memory check. Every so often a peer asks an account about its own old jobs, details that sit on the ledger but were never summarized anywhere, like what it flagged in a jetty repair estimate last month or why it scored an onyx appraisal low. Answers get matched against what it actually wrote. A real agent just remembers. A farm running 300 accounts has to keep 300 separate histories straight, and if one account so much as whispers about a job a different account did, that ties them to one operator.
